guide.greenlantern.shazam.title: Shazam
guide.greenlantern.shazam:
§6The Wizard's Bolt§r
Craft the §6Wizard's Bolt§r and right-click or press §eG§r to say the magic word: lightning falls from the sky and forms Shazam's suit. To turn back into Billy, right-click while sneaking or press §eG§r again, and the lightning falls once more.

§6Shazam's Magic§r
The powers and the flight spend magic, which slowly comes back on its own and three times faster in a thunderstorm. Each "Shazam!" brings back 300 magic (once every 10 seconds), and storm lightning striking him fills it all instead of hurting him.

§6Flight§r
He flies with the flight keys, faster than the Lantern and slower than Supergirl, leaving sparks and little bolts in his trail.
guide.greenlantern.shazam_powers.title: Powers
guide.greenlantern.shazam_powers:
§6Zeus's Lightning§r: Fires a golden bolt from his hand that flies to the first enemy, chases it if it dodges and jumps to two more enemies nearby.
§6Thunder Call§r: He raises his arm and lightning strikes from the sky where he aims, hurting and flinging the enemies around and shattering glass. Works even underground.
§6Speed of Mercury§r: Dashes 14 blocks in a straight line in a red and gold blur, on the ground or in the air, ramming each enemy once and stopping at walls.
§6Strength of Hercules§r: He punches the ground and sends out a shockwave around him that throws enemies away and raises dust.
§6Courage of Achilles§r: A battle cry in a cone that stuns the enemies ahead and puts out fire and torches.
§6Stamina of Atlas§r: While on, he is as heavy as a mountain: he can't be knocked back, takes half damage and doesn't get hungry. Costs per second.
§6Wisdom of Solomon§r: While on, makes every hostile creature within 32 blocks glow, even behind walls, and shows the health of whoever he aims at on the HUD. Costs per second.
guide.greenlantern.controls_shazam.title: Controls
guide.greenlantern.controls_shazam:
§eRight-click§r (Wizard's Bolt): "Shazam!" or use the power.
§eSneak + right-click§r: back to Billy.
§eG§r: say "Shazam!" / back to Billy.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power menu / next power.
§eV§r: use the selected power.
§eDouble tap jump§r: take off / stop flying.
§eW§r while flying: speed up. §eCtrl§r: speed up faster. §eS§r: air brake.
